Maya (People Ops): FYI new hire Marco Cruz (marco.cruz@example.com) is slated to start Tue 4/12. He's currently in AZ and can't make an SF office visit on day 1. Need to sort I-9 alternative + equipment pickup.

Ethan (Recruiter): Marco's available on Tue afternoon if someone local can be his authorized rep, otherwise he'd need a notary or we use the Authorized Representative affidavit. He asked about mailing the laptop vs in-person pickup.

Jin (IT): We can ship overnight or hold for pickup at SF reception. Shipping needs signed asset acceptance before we send. If pickup, we can mark "Hold for Marco Cruz" and preload VPN cert. Which do you prefer?

Liam (Security): Reception can hold items. If it's for pickup by Marco we need ID match. For an authorized rep pickup, we need written authorization from Marco + photo of rep ID.

Maya (People Ops): Prefer in-person pickup if possible to avoid shipping risk. But Marco prefers not to travel. Let's prepare both flows. I'll list steps.

Maya (People Ops): ```Remote I-9 + pickup options:
Option A (Authorized Rep):
- Marco uploads scanned passport/driver license to secure HR intake portal
- Marco completes and signs the Authorized Representative form naming the agent
- Agent (third party) presents originals to reception for pickup and signs Section 2 affidavit
- People Ops files exception and schedules in-person verification within 3 business days of Marco's first workday

Option B (Notarized Enrollment):
- Marco obtains a notary who completes Section 2 in-person with originals
- Notary returns completed I-9 docs and notarization seal to People Ops (scanned + physical mailed copy)
- People Ops flags for audit and schedules in-person verification if policy requires
```

hr-bot: Background check (ClearCheck) status: PENDING - SSN trace mismatch. Action: candidate to confirm SSN or provide supporting docs. Upload link sent: https://clearcheck.vendor/secure/upload/abc123

Ethan (Recruiter): Marco says the SSN on his paperwork had a typo. I'll ask him to re-upload and confirm. Also he prefers a courier shipment if possible.

Jin (IT): Courier shipment ok. I'll open a ticket to stage a MacBook Air (asset A99823) and request overnight label. Marco will need to sign the asset receipt. Please confirm shipping address after BG clears.

Liam (Security): If we ship, we'll mark the item as "Do not open until verified" and include tamper seal. If pickup by authorized rep, reception will verify agent affidavit + agent ID.

Maya (People Ops): Note: Do NOT post scans of IDs or SSNs in Slack. Use secure HR intake only (hr@redwood.com or the intake portal). :no_entry:

Ethan (Recruiter): I'll update Greenhouse and post the authorization template to Marco if he chooses an agent.

Maya (People Ops): Good. I'll keep this thread open until BG clears and the I-9 path is confirmed. If Marco opts for courier, people-ops will coordinate shipping + asset sign-off. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
